You Didn't Know Credit Cards Make Money Even When You Pay on Time.
What if I told you that your credit card company can make money from you… even if you never pay a single cent in interest?
Most people think credit card companies only make money when customers are in debt.
But that's not the whole story.
Imagine you walk into a store and buy a $100 pair of shoes using your credit card.
But the store might receive slightly less than that.
Because businesses pay fees to process card payments.
And part of those fees can go to the bank that issued your credit card.
So even if you pay your entire bill on time…
your card issuer can still earn money from your purchases.
The more you use your card, the more opportunities there are for those fees to add up.
Of course, card issuers can also earn money from interest and other charges.
They don't always need you to be in debt to make a profit.
You didn't know that about money.
